name: Tutorial 6: Add an Option
author: neostryder
description:
Tutorial 5's mod with one thing added: a switch the player controls. The congratulation is now a toggle on this mod's own screen, off until they turn it on.

See docs/modding/tutorials/06-add-an-option.md.

rules.title: Congratulate me on gaining a level
rules.description: Puts "Congratulations!" in front of the level-up message. Nothing else changes.
